$Comment: The Yeti's daily Claim, the bigger one: his fight's script grants it at his death, and each player who fought him finds one in the chest where he fell (and on their Claims tab), rolled from Christmas_Yeti_Daily and scaled by their share of the fight (ShareScaled). Diminish is left out, so the first win each day pays and later wins that day pay nothing; a roll that lands nothing never spends the day. Its row is titled with the fight's own name.
